claim: Allersee is a near-1km sandy-beach inland bathing lake guarded by DLRG on weekends May to October and was the first certified Guarded Beach inland lake in Germany.
quote: The DLRG awarded the Allersee the 'Guarded Beach' certificate in 2009, making Wolfsburg's Allersee the first certified inland bathing lake in Germany. The Allersee is guarded by the DLRG at weekends from May to October.

claim: SUP boards can be rented at the Colombian Pavilion on weekends 11:00-17:00 with 10 boards available, and also from the monkeyman high ropes course.
quote: at the Colombian Pavilion you have the possibility to borrow boards at the weekend between 11am and 5pm with 10 boards on offer

claim: BadeLand's Spaßbad (fun pool) opens Mon-Fri 10:00-21:00 and weekends/holidays 9:00-21:00; Sauna runs Mon-Fri 11:00-22:00.
quote: Spaßbad: Mon-Fri: 10:00-21:00; Sat-Sun: 9:00-21:00; Holidays/School breaks: 9:00-21:00. Sauna: Mon-Fri: 11:00-22:00

claim: BadeLand Spaßbad adult day passes are €11.10–€13.10 weekdays (about €1 more on weekends/holidays), with family cards from €35.10 covering up to 4 people (max 2 adults).
quote: Adults: €11.10–€13.10 (3-4 hours/day pass); €7.70 (evening rate from 7 PM); Family Cards: 'Gültig für 4 Personen, davon maximal 2 Erwachsene' starting at €35.10 weekdays

claim: Allerpark groups the Volkswagen Arena (30,000 capacity, VfL Wolfsburg), EisArena (Grizzlys Wolfsburg ice hockey), BadeLand, monkeyman ropes course, a 6-mast Wakepark, skate sculpture and B'MOOVD bowling on one walkable site, plus 9 water-sports clubs.
quote: Volkswagen Arena: Home ground of VfL Wolfsburg with a capacity of 30,000 spectators. ... Wakepark: Wakeboard, water ski and kneeboard on the only 6-mast facility on an artificial lake!

claim: Monkeyman has three low courses at 1.5m and five high courses 4–13m for climbers age 8+ and 1.40m height, with mini courses for kids over 1m up to age 10.
quote: three low ropes sections at a height of 1.5 metres and five high ropes sections at heights varying between four and 13 metres ... from age 8 and a minimum height of 1.40m

claim: BernsteinSee in Sassenburg (~95,000 m², up to 16m deep) is a clean white-sand-beach lake quality-tested every three months, drawing up to 3,000 swimmers per summer weekend.
quote: covers approximately 95,000 m² with a depth of around 16 meters ... 'all 3 Monate durch amtliche Tests' (every 3 months through official testing). ... Summer weekends attract up to 3,000 visitors.

claim: BernsteinSee sits a few minutes by car from Wolfsburg on the Elbe-Seitenkanal and offers waterskiing, wakeboarding, beach club, go-karting, adventure golf, archery and beach volleyball.
quote: located just a few minutes drive by car from Wolfsburg ... water skiing, wakeboarding, beach club, go-karting, adventure golf, archery, and beach volleyball

claim: Wolfsburg's official leisure cycling routes include the Aller-Radweg (~250km, 27km in Wolfsburg), the Drömling 48km loop, the 50km Storchenroute and the 62km AllerHoheit.
quote: Aller-Radweg: 'stretches over circa 250 kilometers' along the Aller River, with about 27 km through Wolfsburg ... Drömling: A 48-kilometer roundtrip route northeast of the city ... AllerHoheit: '62 kilometers'

claim: The Aller-Radweg is a 5-stage long-distance route linking Verden on the Weser via Celle, Gifhorn, Wolfsburg and Oebisfelde to the source near the Magdeburger Börde, rideable in either direction.
quote: divided into 5 daily stages, but can also be planned individually according to personal requirements, with entry possible at any point and in either direction

claim: Klieversberg is a 110m hill at the edge of the city centre with a 2-3 hour Geopfad circular trail through Jurassic limestone, an animal enclosure and a memorial viewpoint over Wolfsburg and the Allertal.
quote: The Klieversberg is a 110m high hill in the immediate vicinity of the city centre of Wolfsburg ... The entire route takes about 2-3 hours ... From the memorial on the Klieversberg you can enjoy a unique view of Wolfsburg and the Allertal.

claim: The Drömling between Wolfsburg and Calvörde became a transnational UNESCO biosphere reserve in 2023 and is explored via cycling and hiking trails including the long-distance Drömlingsstieg.
quote: Since 2023, the Drömling has been a transnational UNESCO biosphere reserve that can be explored using several cycling and hiking trails

claim: Tankumsee, southwest of Wolfsburg near Isenbüttel, has a fine sandy beach and bathing areas on a popular 8.9km Aller-Canal–Tankumsee-Beach loop walk.
quote: The most popular hiking route is the Aller Canal – Tankumsee Beach loop from Samtgemeinde Isenbüttel, which is 5.5 miles (8.9 km). The Tankumsee has bathing areas.

claim: The Mittellandkanal cycling route runs through Wolfsburg with well-maintained towpaths past the Volkswagen factory and on into the Drömling nature park.
quote: leads along the Mittelland Canal, which runs through the entire city and offers a picturesque backdrop with green banks and historic locks, with well-maintained cycle paths along the canal
